known_issues: class_weight=null — no correction for priority class imbalance
false-high rate not tracked as a metric
training data contained low 40% / medium 35% / high 20% / critical 5% distribution — low was over-represented
synthetic generator had no false-urgency prevention training examples
rule-based classifier: deadline+device-failure patterns scored MEDIUM instead of HIGH
rule-based classifier: tickets with 'ASAP'/'urgent' + trivial request scored HIGH (false-high)

changes: Added HIGH keywords: 'deadline today' (5.0), 'deadline this' (4.5), 'have a deadline' (4.0), 'has a deadline' (4.0) — fixes missed HIGH on deadline+device-failure tickets
Added HIGH keywords: 'won't turn on at all' (5.0), 'computer won't turn on' (5.0), 'won't start at all' (5.0), 'doesn't turn on' (4.5) — device completely unusable

Added LOW keywords for false-urgency prevention: 'can i get a new' (5.5), 'choosing between' (5.5), 'when is the next' (5.5), 'a bit old' (5.0), 'get a new mouse/keyboard/monitor' (5.5), 'it training' (4.5), 'training session' (4.5) — counterweights urgency words in trivial requests
Updated PRIORITY_WEIGHTS: low 0.40→0.30, high 0.20→0.27, critical 0.05→0.08 — reduces low-class dominance, adds more high/critical training signal
Added 4 false-urgency hardware templates with 'low' label (e.g., 'ASAP: need replacement keyboard', 'Important: laptop choice help')
Added 3 false-urgency 'other' category templates with 'low' label (e.g., 'Urgent: when is IT training?', 'ASAP: IT training schedule')
Added 2 false-urgency feature_request templates with 'low' label (e.g., 'ASAP: need better reports')
Added false_high_rate metric: counts LOW/MEDIUM tickets predicted as HIGH/CRITICAL — tracks the core behavioral issue
Added false_high_count and false_high_denominator to evaluation output and model card metrics
Added 'False-high rate < 15%' as explicit success criterion in evaluate_best_on_test()
false_high_rate now persisted to model card JSON for longitudinal tracking
Added 3 false-urgency edge cases (expected LOW): ASAP for new mouse, urgent IT training inquiry, ASAP choosing monitors
Added 2 HIGH edge cases with deadline context: laptop+presentation deadline, VPN drops+client meeting
